title: Biodegradable plastics in soils: sources, degradation, and effects
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00754A, Critical Review

Piumi Amasha Withana, Xiangzhou Yuan, Darvin Im, Yujin Choi, Michael S. Bank, Carol Sze Ki Lin, Sung Yeon Hwang, Yong Sik Ok
Biodegradable plastic degradation in soils is highly complex. Without effective management, degradation poses potential risks to environmental and human health, soil quality, food security and safety, and environmental sustainability.
